profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / System Admin at Clarkson Construction Company
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer and Systems Admin with a background that spans heavy civil construction, network engineering, enterprise infrastructure, cloud architecture, software development, automation, and AI.

What differentiates my experience is that I understand both the physical operation and the technology behind it. I’ve inspected roadway paving and materials in the field, worked with batch plants, scale houses, and construction equipment, engineered enterprise networks and cloud environments, and developed software and automation for those same operational environments. That perspective allows me to approach technology not simply as code or infrastructure, but as a tool for solving real world problems.

At Clarkson Construction Company, my work has progressed from enterprise IT and infrastructure into software engineering, systems integration, and agentic AI development. I design applications, APIs, automation platforms, data pipelines, and AI driven workflows using technologies including React, TypeScript, Java, Python, PowerShell, Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, and REST APIs.

My infrastructure background includes network engineering, Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, identity and access management, SSO, cybersecurity, cloud migrations, SharePoint, VoIP, MDM, and enterprise networking. I’ve designed technology environments for offices, construction facilities, and field operations while helping modernize legacy infrastructure into cloud first architectures.

Today, I’m especially focused on applying AI and software engineering to heavy civil construction and enterprise operations, from agentic CMMC/NIST compliance workflows and enterprise integrations, to specialized automation connecting software with paving equipment and roadway construction processes.

Earlier in my career, I worked in large enterprise networking environments, including supporting T-Mobile during the Sprint acquisition, as network engineering contractor. Covid made thing’s strange so I took on a different type of engineering and began my career in heavy civil quality control and roadway inspection.

I enjoy problems that cross boundaries like, software, infrastructure, data, AI, engineering, and the physical world. If a repetitive process can be automated, a disconnected system can be integrated, or an operational problem can be solved with technology, that’s usually where you’ll find me.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As The Senior Software Engineer

I bring a unique perspective that bridges physical construction operations with modern technology. My background spans heavy civil roadway and paving inspection, scale houses and batch plants, enterprise infrastructure, cloud architecture, and software engineering allowing me to design technology with a firsthand understanding of the environments it serves.

I help lead the design and development of custom software, AI driven automation, system integrations, and data solutions supporting heavy civil construction, enterprise operations, compliance, and field technology.

Architect and develop agentic AI workflows, API integrations, edge functions, data pipelines, and automation services that connect enterprise systems and transform operational data into actionable intelligence. Design custom algorithms and computational logic for engineering, mathematical, and construction specific applications.

Develop specialized heavy civil software, including automation integrating paving equipment with automated roadway rebar placement and other real world machine workflows.

Engineer enterprise applications and automation using React, Java, TypeScript, Python, PowerShell, APIs, Microsoft Power Platform, and cloud services, including payroll processing, data transformation, administrative automation, and system-management tools.

Develop CMMC/NIST-focused agentic solutions for control assessment, evidence review, and security posture analysis.

Engineer APIs, integration layers, and data crawling services while advancing AI-enabled architecture that combines autonomous agents, deterministic automation, and traditional software to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
positions.insights: Agentic AI Development, Python in Azure and +37 skills

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As System Administrator

I Architect and administer enterprise infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Intune, networking, identity, cybersecurity, communications, and cloud services supporting Clarkson and affiliated companies.

Played a key role in transitioning the organization from traditional on-premises Active Directory and domain controller infrastructure to a cloud first Microsoft environment utilizing Entra ID, Intune, Azure, and Microsoft 365.

Designed and implemented Intune MDM and endpoint management architecture, including enrollment strategies, security baselines, configuration profiles, application deployments, compliance controls, update rings, Windows Hello, and automated device/user lifecycle processes.

Engineered dynamic identity and access management solutions using Entra ID groups, user attributes, licensing, application assignments, and automated provisioning. Implemented SSO and identity provider integrations across numerous enterprise platforms to centralize authentication and strengthen access governance.

Architected Microsoft 365 backup and resiliency solutions and designed SharePoint environments, permissions, document architectures, migrations, synchronization strategies, and automated workflows.

Designed and implemented network, VoIP, security camera, access control, and infrastructure solutions for corporate offices, construction facilities, and affiliated companies, including RhysIvy and Global’s 1801 facility. Designed RhysIvy’s Microsoft 365 environment and led its migration from Google Workspace.

Implemented specialized enterprise and construction systems including Primavera P6 database environments, scale house technology, industrial sensors, networking, APIs, and operational data integrations.

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description:
As a IT Support Specialist

I Provided enterprise IT support while expanding into systems administration, network engineering, infrastructure deployment, automation, identity management, and technology modernization across Clarkson’s corporate and field environments.

Designed and supported LAN/WAN infrastructure, switching, routing, VLANs, Wi-Fi, fiber, firewalls, VPNs, printers, endpoints, mobile devices, and specialized field technology across offices, construction sites, scale houses, and operational facilities.

Administered Active Directory, Windows Server, domain controllers, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file services, permissions, and endpoint infrastructure, helping establish the foundation for Clarkson’s transition toward cloud based identity and device management.

Led the implementation and overhaul of the helpdesk platform, improving ticket management, documentation, asset visibility, escalation, and IT service workflows. Managed device deployment, imaging, patching, software distribution, troubleshooting, and hardware lifecycle management while introducing PowerShell automation.

Supported Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, identity, licensing, security, and application integrations. Managed Windows and Apple environments and developed Power Automate workflows to automate administrative and business processes.

Implemented construction technology including scale-house systems, moisture sensors, industrial scales, field networking, GPS technology, and data integrations, bridging enterprise IT with operational technology.

The role evolved from technical support into infrastructure, networking, automation, and systems engineering, establishing the foundation for advancement into Systems Administration and Software Engineering.

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
As a IT Helpdesk / Support Technician

I Provided entry level IT helpdesk and technical support while attending college, gaining hands on experience with desktop support, troubleshooting, networking, and general IT operations.

Supported users with common hardware, software, printer, account, and connectivity issues across Windows workstations and business applications. Assisted with computer setup, software installation, system updates, password resets, user access, and basic network troubleshooting.

Diagnosed technical issues involving desktops, laptops, peripherals, printers, internet connectivity, and local network resources, escalating more complex problems when necessary.

Helped deploy and configure new computers and equipment, including workstation setup, peripheral installation, and basic user configuration.

Documented support issues and resolutions while learning proper helpdesk procedures, troubleshooting methodology, customer service, and IT documentation practices.

Used the position as an opportunity to develop practical IT experience alongside college coursework, building the technical foundation in systems, networking, troubleshooting, and user support that later progressed into systems administration and infrastructure engineering responsibilities.
